# gramlot-examples 0.3.28

Makes lesson code easier to study: repeated headings and explanatory prose move to the Explanation material, while controls, bindings and observable results stay in the example. Validation variants have dedicated reusable blocks; window examples distinguish default dialogs, movable dialogs and floating windows. Database grid examples separate toolbar, measurements and columns into small methods without changing their server queries.

Grouplet guide content comes from the sample Data Bag, demonstrating relative bindings and preserving edited data across guide reloads. All 132 common lessons were checked in Python and JavaScript. Focused checks cover narrow and wide layouts, Chromium and WebKit, serverless guide exports opened from file, SQLite and PageStore interactions. The 21 existing endpoint and PageStore bodies in the edited modules remain unchanged.

Requires the current Gramlot runtime. Core and server packages remain at 0.3.26. Public galleries keep Remote Edit disabled and preserve the separately maintained native mobile catalogue. The Invoice application remains outside this release.

Fixes nested gallery navigation when an environment contributes pages to an existing topic. Common and environment subdirectories are merged only within their respective registered roots; traversal, absent paths and escaping symlinks remain rejected. The deployment rehearsal caught this defect before promotion. The 0.3.27 publication was cancelled before producing a release; its tag is preserved.
